hook_text: Count the same street twice, by two different roads — and the books catch their own mistakes.
clip_script: The pages are written line by line, person by person, every day. The control line is fed by column totals, once a month. Same transactions, two independent journeys — so at month end, the sum of all the pages MUST land exactly on the control line's balance. When two separate counts of the same street agree, you can trust both. When they differ, one journey dropped a passenger — and you know to search before the month closes. Counting the street twice is not double work. It is the street auditing itself.
visual_style: A street of houses, each with a glowing balance; two animated paths — one hopping house to house, one sweeping the whole street — meeting at a single agreeing number.
pacing: Two parallel journeys animated side by side, converging beat, dramatic pause on the mismatch, satisfying click when they agree.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to run the whole control account, both directions.
